SPALLETTI: WE WANT TO DICTATE THE GAMEThe Men’s First Team host AC Milan on Matchday 3 of the 2026/27 Serie A season, with both teams having won their opening two matches of the season.Coach Luciano Spalletti spoke to the press ahead of Sunday’s clash, which takes place at 20:45 CEST at the Allianz Stadium.MILAN AT THE ALLIANZ STADIUM"He [Ruben Amorim] is a coach with clear ideas, who has managed to build a strong team. Although only two matches have been played, you can already see very recognisable patterns of play. It’s a direct, vertical side that goes straight at you and is very quick on the counter-attack. They force you to match their pace, otherwise you risk missing the key moments.

ℹ️ #Juventus, summer mercato balance sheet:💸 Incoming operations - including amortization of new signings, loan fees, and gross salaries, are expected to translated into increased costs of approximately €98.05M for the 2026/27 financial year.💰 Outgoing operations are expected to have a positive impact of approximately €92.76M on the 2026/27 financial year. This total is reached by combining capital gains/losses, loan revenues, savings on amortization and savings on the gross wages of players that left.[Calcio&Finanza via @juventusinsidernews]

📋 #Milik and #Thuram out of #Juventus's Serie A list ⚪️⚫️Between now and January, 2 slots remain available to modify it.At this moment, #Milik can only be utilized in the Coppa Italia and could re-enter the list if a spot opens up.[IlBianconero]
#Milik out of the Serie A list[Romeo Agresti]

👋🧐 "#Juventus has four deadweights: the first problem is #Cabal, who is injured. Then there is #Gatti, who is not even 2% happy to stay and no longer wants to be part of the rotation. Then there is the #Zhegrova situation, with a few windows of opportunity still open in certain mercato. Finally, there is #Milik. The management, therefore, needs to clear out the elements that are not helping."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🤕⁉️ #Yildiz will not return before the end of November, while #Thuram will return in January 2027. #Ekhator will be out for 45/50 days and #Cabal for 1 months. #McKennie (persistent muscle fatigue), #Sarr (a muscle issue carried over from his time at #Tottenham) and #Cambiaso (sprained ankle) are in doubt. For the latter, a late fitness test in the coming hours will be decisive. Objective: try a lightning-fast recovery to at least make it to the bench.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇵🇹🆙 #Spalletti foresees a tactical and execution-level evolution in #Conceição similar to the one accomplished with #Salah at #Roma: for this reason, he asked to lock him down, pushing back on the Premier League. A desire also shared by the player, who crushed any negotiations in their infancy by telling Mendes: "I am not moving from here". He feels perfectly integrated in Turin and wants to win as a bianconero.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🔍 Possible lineups #Juve-#Milan:#JUVENTUS (4-2-3-1): Vicario; Kalulu, Bremer, Lucumí, Celik; Locatelli, Douglas Luiz; Francisco Conceiçao, Nico Gonzalez, Boga; Kolo Muani. Coach: Luciano Spalletti.#MILAN (3-4-2-1): Maignan; Gila, De Winter, Pavlovic; Chukwueze, Modric, Musah, Bartesaghi; Rabiot, Cissé; Gonçalo Ramos. [Di Marzio via @AverageJuventinoGuy]
Good training week of Alajbegovic. Reports from La Continassa are good. Doesn’t mean he’ll start but he trained really well.[Momblano via Juventibus]

Rest Hours before (Prima) & after (Dopo) European games for the Italian teams. [QuotidianoBN]Example:Juventus rest 96h15 before 1st European game. Plays in Serie A 69h after European game has been played.4 first European games with before / after have been calculated.Do you notice something?

Nico #González Has Captivated LucioTomorrow #Juve-#Milan (8:45 PM)#Spalletti is counting on the Argentine from the start. #Woltemade will begin from the bench. #Amorim must break a three-year taboo.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

DESPICABLE ME!#Kolo needs to unlock himself: and he agrees with #Spalletti.The Frenchman is still without a goal after missing major chances: "The coach asks me to be more aggressive and it's true, I need to give it my all. I am willing to do anything for him. A duo with #Woltemade? Hopefully: he is great". What a battle against #Ramos, the other striker discarded by #PSG. Serena: "Nico can become Lucio's #Dybala.[Front Page TuttoSport]

⚡️‼️ "#Juventus failed to sign #Tagliafico because #Cabal stayed, causing the transfer puzzle to collapse. Another name the club considered was #AitNouri, who was contemplating a departure, but #ManchesterCity vetoed the move, refusing to release him or sell him. Contacts were also made for #Miranda, but without finding the right conditions. On the other hand, #EmersonPalmieri was never evaluated by the club.[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🔙🧐 "Among the players that #Juventus evaluated after having lost #Kessié was #Amrabat as well. He was a low-cost name that the management took into consideration, but he had already given his word to #Ajax. The bianconeri are, nonetheless, very happy to have gone for #Sarr, after also evaluating a stopgap solution. In fact, he is viewed as a player that can have a real future at the club."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "Sedorf #Owusu is a midfielder who undoubtedly performed well in the pre-season, and it is no coincidence that he ended up on the UEFA list of #Juventus.He will certainly train frequently with the first team.However, it is difficult to understand why pre-season minutes were given to players who would later leave, like #Arthur, while ignoring the youngsters on tour with the team.At 21 years old, he is no longer just a boy and already has experience in football that matters."[@romeoagresti on YouTube via @PuebloJ]
